newsitem.title: ITALY: Gemina details 96 warrant holder rights.
newsitem.headline: Gemina details 96 warrant holder rights.

text.p: Industrial and financial holding company Gemina said holders of 1996 warrants would be entitled to subscribe to ordinary shares in Gemina and the newly created company HPI until June 30, 1996.

Gemina, which earlier announced it was hiving off industrial interests into a newly created comany, Holding di Partecipazioni Industriali, said warrant shareholders could subscribe to shares in the two companies in the same proportion that applies to current Gemina shareholders.
Holders of ordinary and savings Gemina shares will receive nine HPI shares of 500 lire nominal value for every 10 Gemina shares held.
